description: A pre-filled River trade link. A buy by ticker with usd (no address or chain) returns a best-price link that opens the cheapest issuer for the user. Give exactly one of usd (buy only, settlement stablecoin, up to 6 decimals) or qty (tokens, up to 18 decimals). The user reviews this on The River and signs in their own wallet; nothing happens until they do.
